create_LabeledImage: create a LabeledImage feature with label names for segmentation tasks
build_LabeledImage_from_path: build a LabeledImage feature with labels loaded from a text file path
test_LabeledImage_num_classes: test the LabeledImage num_classes property returns the correct number of classes
save_LabeledImage_metadata: save LabeledImage metadata including class label names to a data directory
convert_LabeledImage_to_json: convert a LabeledImage feature to JSON content with label metadata
